oh_source.l4_evidence: encode_init allocates av_malloc(4) (WMAV1) / av_mallocz(10) (WMAV2) without AV_INPUT_BUFFER_PADDING_SIZE; upstream diff applies clean to OH checkout

vulnerability.summary: WMA encoder extradata buffer lacks the FFmpeg-mandated input padding, letting downstream consumers that read extradata with padding assumptions read past the allocation (OOB read).
vulnerability.verification_level: source-level confirmed; runtime observation path documented (ASan on the padded-block extradata consumer) but not executed — declared as such
